name: @hollis-labs/surface-genui
description: Generated UI without any styling: the reviewed GenUI contract (strict decoding and validation of surfaces, calls and outcomes) and the controller that takes one surface through an action, a confirmation and recovery. Visuals are the Surface registry's genui-surface component.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/validators.js src/validators.d.ts dist/src/
